Callout.Name: Boat Fire
Callout.Message: Boat on fire at a marina.
Callout.Advisory: Nobody on board, fire spreading to the pontoon.

Script.Line: It went up at the stern. I smelled it before I saw it.
There is fuel aboard. Two hundred litres of it.
It is not my boat. I am watching it for somebody.

Lines.Approach: Nobody aboard and it is trying to take the pontoon with it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
